sources.label: Wikipedia, "11 Ursae Minoris"
sources.quote: 11 Ursae Minoris, formally named Pherkad Minor, is a single star located approximately 410 light-years away in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Minor.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 257 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,254 K, so 29.569 solar radii.

sources.quote: The star is visible to the naked eye as a faint, orange-hued star with an apparent visual magnitude of 5.15.
